tools.name: fs
tools.description:
📂 Simplified filesystem-style document operations. Use the "action" field to select the operation.

Common actions: ls, tree, read, write, replace, reorder, search. Required fields: ls: path; tree: path; read: path; write: path, markdown; replace: path, edit; reorder: path, orderedPaths; search: path, query.

Additional actions: rm, mv. Read siyuan://help/action/fs/{action} for details, or call action="help" if resources are unavailable.

Parameter contract per action (fields outside the action's optional list should not be sent):
fs.ls: required [path] | optional []
fs.tree: required [path] | optional [maxDepth]
fs.read: required [path] | optional [blockStart, blockLimit, tokenBudget, includeBlockIds]
fs.write: required [path, markdown] | optional [overwrite]
fs.replace: required [path, edit] | optional []
fs.rm: required [path] | optional []
fs.mv: required [from, to] | optional []
fs.reorder: required [path, orderedPaths] | optional []
fs.search: required [path, query] | optional [regex, caseSensitive, page, pageSize]

Use fs first for ordinary document file operations: list, tree, read, write, move, reorder, delete, and grep-like search. fs paths are human-readable workspace paths. Prefer /Notebook/Folder/Doc so resolution is unambiguous; a notebook-omitted path such as /Folder/Doc works only when it uniquely matches across readable notebooks. fs outputs canonical paths with the notebook name and hides notebook IDs, block IDs, and storage paths. Requires user confirmation before: rm, mv.

action.description: Action to perform. Supported values: ls, tree, read, write, replace, rm, mv, reorder, search. Use action="help" for the action index, or action="help" with topic="<actionName>" for per-action details. User confirmation is required before calling: rm, mv.

path.description: Human-readable workspace path. Prefer including the notebook name (e.g., /Notebook or /Notebook/Folder) for unambiguous resolution; a notebook-omitted path is accepted only when it uniquely matches across readable notebooks. Use / to list all readable notebooks. / Human-readable workspace document path. Prefer including the notebook name (e.g., /Notebook/Folder/Doc); omitting it is accepted only when the document uniquely matches across readable notebooks. / Human-readable workspace document path. Prefer including the notebook name (e.g., /Notebook/Folder/Doc); omitting it is accepted only when the existing document or parent path uniquely matches across readable notebooks. Root-level creation requires /Notebook/Title. / Human-readable workspace notebook or parent document path. Prefer including the notebook name (e.g., /Notebook or /Notebook/Folder); omission is accepted only for a unique document match. / Human-readable workspace document or folder path. Prefer including the notebook name (e.g., /Notebook or /Notebook/Folder); omitting it is accepted only when the scope uniquely matches across readable notebooks. [Required by: ls, read, reorder, replace, rm, search, tree, write]

maxDepth.description: Max tree depth to return (default 3) [Optional in: tree]

blockStart.description: Zero-based display-block index to start reading from (default 0) [Optional in: read]

blockLimit.description: Optional maximum complete display blocks. Omit to try full text, subject to the 256 KiB hard content limit. [Optional in: read]

tokenBudget.description: Optional soft token budget. Complete blocks may exceed it, but never the 256 KiB hard content limit. [Optional in: read]

includeBlockIds.description: Include a sidecar blockRefs mapping without adding block IDs to Markdown content (default false) [Optional in: read]

markdown.description: Markdown content to create or write. Do not include a leading # Title; a matching create-time H1 is stripped automatically. [Required by: write]

overwrite.description: When true, replace an existing document body while keeping the document node and title. This is a full body replacement. [Optional in: write]

old.description: Original text to match exactly. Supports multi-line strings.

replace_all.description: When true, replace every exact match. Defaults to false.

old.description: Original text to match exactly. Supports multi-line strings.

replace_all.description: When true, replace every exact match. Defaults to false.

edit.description: One replacement edit or an array of edits to apply sequentially inside editable non-complex Markdown blocks without rebuilding the document [Required by: replace]

from.description: Human-readable workspace source document path. Prefer including the notebook name (e.g., /Notebook/Folder/Old); omitting it is accepted only when the source uniquely matches across readable notebooks. [Required by: mv]

to.description: Human-readable workspace destination document path. Prefer including the notebook name (e.g., /Notebook/Folder/New); omitting it is accepted only when the destination parent uniquely matches across readable notebooks. A root-level destination requires /Notebook/Title. [Required by: mv]

orderedPaths.description: Complete ordered list of all visible direct child document workspace paths. Prefer including the notebook name in each path (e.g., /Notebook/Folder/First); an omitted notebook must resolve uniquely. [Required by: reorder]

query.description: Text or regular expression to search for [Required by: search]

regex.description: Treat query as a JavaScript regular expression [Optional in: search]

pageSize.description: Matches per page, default 50 [Optional in: search]

topic.description: Optional. Only used when action="help". Pass an action name (e.g. "create") to get per-action help; omit or use "overview" for the action index.

tools.title: SiYuan Filesystem

outputSchema.description: JSON object corresponding to the tool result. Non-object values are wrapped under value.

tools.name: notebook
tools.description:
📚 Grouped notebook operations. Use the "action" field to select the operation.

Common actions: list, create, set_open_state, rename, get_conf, get_child_docs. Required fields: list: no additional fields; create: name; set_open_state: notebook, opened; rename: notebook, name; get_conf: notebook; get_child_docs: notebook.

Additional actions: set_conf, set_icon, get_permissions. Read siyuan://help/action/notebook/{action} for details, or call action="help" if resources are unavailable.

Parameter contract per action (fields outside the action's optional list should not be sent):
notebook.list: required [] | optional []
notebook.create: required [name] | optional [icon]
notebook.set_open_state: required [notebook, opened] | optional []
notebook.rename: required [notebook, name] | optional []
notebook.get_conf: required [notebook] | optional []
notebook.set_conf: required [notebook, conf] | optional []
notebook.set_icon: required [notebook, icon] | optional []
notebook.get_permissions: required [] | optional [notebook]
notebook.get_child_docs: required [notebook] | optional [page, pageSize]

Use notebook IDs for set_open_state, rename, get_conf, and set_conf. notebook(action="get_permissions") supports notebook="all" (or omission) for all notebooks, and a specific notebook ID for one notebook.

action.description: Action to perform. Supported values: list, create, set_open_state, rename, get_conf, set_conf, set_icon, get_permissions, get_child_docs. Use action="help" for the action index, or action="help" with topic="<actionName>" for per-action details.

name.description: Notebook name / New notebook name [Required by: create, rename]

icon.description: Optional notebook icon. Prefer a Unicode hex code string such as '1f4d4' for 📔 instead of a raw emoji character. / Icon value. Prefer a Unicode hex code string such as '1f4d4' for 📔; raw emoji characters may not render correctly. Custom icon paths are also supported. [Required by: set_icon; Optional in: create]

notebook.description: Notebook ID / Notebook ID, or "all" to return every notebook permission entry. Omit to return all notebooks. [Required by: get_child_docs, get_conf, rename, set_conf, set_icon, set_open_state; Optional in: get_permissions]

opened.description: true to open, false to close [Required by: set_open_state]

pageSize.description: Rows per page, default 50 [Optional in: get_child_docs]

topic.description: Optional. Only used when action="help". Pass an action name (e.g. "create") to get per-action help; omit or use "overview" for the action index.

tools.name: document
tools.description:
📝 Grouped document operations. Use the "action" field to select the operation.

Common actions: create, lookup, rename, get_child_blocks, get_child_docs, search_docs, get_doc, get_outline. Required fields: create: notebook, path | notebook, parentPath, title; lookup: no additional fields; rename: title; get_child_blocks: id; get_child_docs: id; search_docs: notebook, query; get_doc: id; get_outline: id.

Additional actions: ensure_link_targets, move, reorder, set_attr, list_tree, create_daily_note, duplicate, heading_to_doc, doc_to_heading. Read siyuan://help/action/document/{action} for details, or call action="help" if resources are unavailable.

Parameter contract per action (fields outside the action's optional list should not be sent):
document.create: required [notebook, path] OR [notebook, parentPath, title] | optional [markdown, sorts, icon]
document.lookup: required [] | optional [id, notebook, path, hpath, hPath, include]
document.ensure_link_targets: required [notebook, parentId, mode, targets] | optional [markdown, dryRun]
document.rename: required [title] | optional [id, notebook, path]
document.move: required [] | optional [fromPaths, toNotebook, toPath, fromIDs, toID]
document.reorder: required [parentID, orderedIDs] | optional []
document.get_child_blocks: required [id] | optional []
document.get_child_docs: required [id] | optional []
document.set_attr: required [id, attrs] | optional []
document.list_tree: required [notebook, path] | optional [maxDepth]
document.search_docs: required [notebook, query] | optional [path]
document.get_doc: required [id] | optional [mode, size, blockStart, blockLimit, tokenBudget, includeBlockIds]
document.get_outline: required [id] | optional [preview]
document.create_daily_note: required [notebook] | optional [app]
document.duplicate: required [id] | optional []
document.heading_to_doc: required [headingID, targetNotebook] | optional [targetPath, previousPath]
document.doc_to_heading: required [srcID, targetID] | optional [after]

For ordinary document file operations, prefer fs(action="ls"|"tree"|"read"|"write"|"search") because it accepts human-readable paths and hides storage paths and IDs. document(action="create") creates both non-empty and empty documents. Prefer path for child documents; path is a notebook-local human-readable hpath such as /Folder/Parent/New Child, not /Notebook/Folder/... and not a .sy storage path. Requires user confirmation before: move.

action.description: Action to perform. Supported values: create, lookup, ensure_link_targets, rename, move, reorder, get_child_blocks, get_child_docs, set_attr, list_tree, search_docs, get_doc, get_outline, create_daily_note, duplicate, heading_to_doc, doc_to_heading. Use action="help" for the action index, or action="help" with topic="<actionName>" for per-action details. User confirmation is required before calling: move.

notebook.description: Notebook ID / Notebook ID, required with path or hpath / Explicit notebook ID that must own the parent document and every returned target. [Required by: create, create_daily_note, ensure_link_targets, list_tree, search_docs; Optional in: lookup, rename]

path.description: Path value. For action="create", use a human-readable target path RELATIVE TO THE NOTEBOOK ROOT (must start with /, MUST NOT include the notebook name; e.g., /Folder/Weekly Note, not /NotebookName/Folder/Weekly Note). For action="lookup", "list_tree", "search_docs", and path-based rename/remove/move, use a storage path returned by document(action="lookup", id=..., include=["path"]) (or / for list_tree notebook root); use hpath for human-readable lookup. [Required by: list_tree; Optional in: lookup, rename, search_docs; Required in a parameter combination: create]

parentPath.description: Parent path for title-based creation, RELATIVE TO THE NOTEBOOK ROOT. Accepts a human-readable path (must start with /, MUST NOT include the notebook name; e.g., /Folder) or a storage path ending in .sy returned by document(action="lookup"). [Required in a parameter combination: create]

title.description: Required together with parentPath when create omits path; notebook + title alone is invalid / New document title [Required by: rename; Required in a parameter combination: create]

markdown.description: Markdown content, defaults to empty. Do not include a leading # Title; a matching H1 is stripped automatically. / Optional Markdown body for every target created by mode="create". Existing targets are never edited. [Optional in: create, ensure_link_targets]

sorts.description: Compatibility option retained for older callers; title-based creation now uses the reliable path flow [Optional in: create]

icon.description: Optional document icon. Prefer a Unicode hex code string such as '1f4d4' for 📔 instead of a raw emoji character. [Optional in: create]

id.description: Document ID to look up / Document ID / Source document ID [Required by: duplicate, get_child_blocks, get_child_docs, get_doc, get_outline, set_attr; Optional in: lookup, rename]

hpath.description: Human-readable notebook-local path to look up when notebook is provided. MUST NOT include the notebook name (e.g., /Folder/Doc, not /Notebook/Folder/Doc) [Optional in: lookup]

hPath.description: Alias for hpath (notebook-local, MUST NOT include the notebook name) [Optional in: lookup]

parentId.description: Explicit parent document ID. Only direct child documents of this resolved parent are in scope. [Required by: ensure_link_targets]

mode.description: resolve/reuse accept exact existing IDs without title fallback; create accepts explicit new titles and refuses to adopt same-title children. / Return mode: "markdown" (default) or "html" [Required by: ensure_link_targets; Optional in: get_doc]

key.description: Stable caller key used in the returned link map. It is not resolved as a document title.

id.description: Explicit existing document ID. Required for mode="resolve" and mode="reuse".

title.description: Explicit title for a new direct child document. Allowed only for mode="create" and never used to adopt an existing document.

targets.description: Explicit link targets. keys must be unique; IDs are identities, while titles are only new-document names. [Required by: ensure_link_targets]

dryRun.description: Plan and inspect the explicit scope without creating documents. For strict creation preflight, use validateOnly=true instead. [Optional in: ensure_link_targets]

fromPaths.description: Source storage paths returned by document(action="lookup"). [Optional in: move]

toPath.description: Target storage path. Use the storage path of an existing destination document returned by document(action="lookup"). [Optional in: move]

parentID.description: Notebook ID or parent document ID [Required by: reorder]

orderedIDs.description: Complete ordered list of all visible direct child document IDs [Required by: reorder]

icon.description: Icon value. Prefer a Unicode hex code string such as '1f4d4'.

cover.description: Cover source. Use null or empty string to clear the cover.

attrs.description: Document metadata attributes to set [Required by: set_attr]

maxDepth.description: Max tree depth to return (default 3). Deeper nodes are collapsed to childCount. [Optional in: list_tree]

query.description: Keyword to search in document titles [Required by: search_docs]

size.description: Optional maximum content size hint [Optional in: get_doc]

blockStart.description: Zero-based display-block index to start reading from in markdown mode (default 0) [Optional in: get_doc]

blockLimit.description: Optional maximum complete display blocks in markdown mode. Omit to try full text, subject to the 256 KiB hard content limit. [Optional in: get_doc]

tokenBudget.description: Optional soft token budget for markdown. Complete blocks may exceed it, but never the 256 KiB hard content limit. [Optional in: get_doc]

includeBlockIds.description: Include a sidecar blockRefs mapping in markdown mode without adding block IDs to content (default false) [Optional in: get_doc]

preview.description: Use SiYuan preview-mode outline semantics (default false) [Optional in: get_outline]

app.description: Optional app identifier passed through to SiYuan [Optional in: create_daily_note]

headingID.description: Heading block ID to convert into a document [Required by: heading_to_doc]

targetPath.description: Optional target storage path [Optional in: heading_to_doc]

previousPath.description: Optional previous sibling storage path [Optional in: heading_to_doc]

targetID.description: Target document or heading block ID [Required by: doc_to_heading]

after.description: When true, insert after the target heading instead of before it [Optional in: doc_to_heading]

topic.description: Optional. Only used when action="help". Pass an action name (e.g. "create") to get per-action help; omit or use "overview" for the action index.

tools.name: block
tools.description:
🧱 Grouped block operations. Use the "action" field to select the operation.

Common actions: insert, prepend, append, update, replace, get_kramdown, batch_kramdown, get_children, get_attrs, info. Required fields: insert: no additional fields; prepend: dataType, data, parentID; append: dataType, data, parentID; update: no additional fields; replace: id, edit; get_kramdown: id; batch_kramdown: ids; get_children: id; get_attrs: id; info: id.

Additional actions: move, set_fold_state, transfer_references, set_attrs, breadcrumb, dom, recent_updated, word_count, add_to_daily_note, docs_info. Read siyuan://help/action/block/{action} for details, or call action="help" if resources are unavailable.

Parameter contract per action (fields outside the action's optional list should not be sent):
block.insert: required [] | optional [dataType, data, nextID, previousID, parentID, blocks]
block.prepend: required [dataType, data, parentID] | optional []
block.append: required [dataType, data, parentID] | optional []
block.update: required [] | optional [dataType, data, id, items]
block.replace: required [id, edit] | optional []
block.move: required [] | optional [id, ids, previousID, parentID]
block.set_fold_state: required [id, folded] | optional []
block.get_kramdown: required [id] | optional []
block.batch_kramdown: required [ids] | optional [mode]
block.get_children: required [id] | optional [page, pageSize]
block.transfer_references: required [fromID, toID] | optional [refIDs]
block.set_attrs: required [id, attrs] | optional []
block.get_attrs: required [id] | optional []
block.info: required [id] | optional []
block.breadcrumb: required [id] | optional [excludeTypes]
block.dom: required [id] | optional []
block.recent_updated: required [] | optional [count]
block.word_count: required [ids] | optional []
block.add_to_daily_note: required [notebook, dataType, data, position] | optional []
block.docs_info: required [] | optional [id, ids, refCount, av]

block(action="prepend") or block(action="append") with a document ID targets the document start or end. block(action="update") is best for single-block replacement. One table, fenced code block, or list may contain many lines and still be one block. Use append/prepend/insert for multiple sibling blocks; verify the resulting structure after replacement. Requires user confirmation before: move.

action.description: Action to perform. Supported values: insert, prepend, append, update, replace, move, set_fold_state, get_kramdown, batch_kramdown, get_children, transfer_references, set_attrs, get_attrs, info, breadcrumb, dom, recent_updated, word_count, add_to_daily_note, docs_info. Use action="help" for the action index, or action="help" with topic="<actionName>" for per-action details. User confirmation is required before calling: move.

dataType.description: Data format [Required by: add_to_daily_note, append, prepend; Optional in: insert, update]

data.description: Block content / New block content [Required by: add_to_daily_note, append, prepend; Optional in: insert, update]

previousID.description: Sibling block ID to position after. For block(action="move"), provide previousID, parentID, or both to describe the destination. Successful moves return a structured success object. [Optional in: insert, move]

parentID.description: Parent block or document ID. With prepend/append, a document ID targets the document head or tail; a block ID targets that block's child list. [Required by: append, prepend; Optional in: insert, move]

blocks.description: Blocks to insert. Item-level anchors override top-level parentID/previousID/nextID. [Optional in: insert]

id.description: Block ID / Single block ID / Foldable block ID / Block ID or document ID / Single document/block ID [Required by: breadcrumb, dom, get_attrs, get_children, get_kramdown, info, replace, set_attrs, set_fold_state; Optional in: docs_info, move, update]

old.description: Original text to match exactly. Supports multi-line strings.

replace_all.description: When true, replace every exact match. Defaults to false.

old.description: Original text to match exactly. Supports multi-line strings.

replace_all.description: When true, replace every exact match. Defaults to false.

edit.description: One replacement edit or an array of edits to apply sequentially within the same block kramdown [Required by: replace]

ids.description: Multiple block IDs to move as a group. Pass IDs in the desired final order; the tool calls SiYuan's low-level move API from last to first internally to preserve that order. / Block or document IDs. Results preserve this input order, including duplicate IDs. / One or more block IDs / Document IDs [Required by: batch_kramdown, word_count; Optional in: docs_info, move]

folded.description: true to fold, false to unfold [Required by: set_fold_state]

mode.description: Kramdown export mode: "md" (default) or "textmark" [Optional in: batch_kramdown]

pageSize.description: Items per page, default 50 [Optional in: get_children]

excludeTypes.description: Optional block types to exclude from the breadcrumb [Optional in: breadcrumb]

count.description: Maximum number of recent readable blocks to return after permission filtering [Optional in: recent_updated]

position.description: Where to add content in today's daily note [Required by: add_to_daily_note]

refCount.description: When true, include reference counts [Optional in: docs_info]

av.description: When true, include AV metadata [Optional in: docs_info]

topic.description: Optional. Only used when action="help". Pass an action name (e.g. "create") to get per-action help; omit or use "overview" for the action index.

tools.name: av
tools.description:
🗃️ Grouped attribute-view (database) operations. Use the "action" field to select the operation.

Common actions: get, render, get_attribute_view_keys, get_attribute_view_filter_sort, search, get_primary_key_values. Required fields: get: avID; render: no additional fields; get_attribute_view_keys: avID; get_attribute_view_filter_sort: avID; search: keyword; get_primary_key_values: avID.

Additional actions: add_rows, remove_rows, add_column, remove_column, set_cells, set_column_options, duplicate_rows, duplicate, add_view, set_filters, set_sorts, set_group, set_column_visibility, set_column_order, set_new_item_templates, create_from_template, configure_two_way_relation, configure_rollup, set_relation. Read siyuan://help/action/av/{action} for details, or call action="help" if resources are unavailable.

Parameter contract per action (fields outside the action's optional list should not be sent):
av.get: required [avID] | optional [blockID, id]
av.render: required [] | optional [avID, blockID, viewID, page, pageSize, query, groupPaging, createIfNotExist, id]
av.get_attribute_view_keys: required [avID] | optional [id]
av.get_attribute_view_filter_sort: required [avID] | optional [blockID, id]
av.search: required [keyword] | optional [excludes]
av.add_rows: required [avID] | optional [blockIDs, primaryKeyTexts, blockID, viewID, groupID, previousID, ignoreDefaultFill]
av.remove_rows: required [avID, srcIDs] | optional [blockID]
av.add_column: required [avID, keyName, keyType] | optional [blockID, keyID, keyIcon, previousKeyID]
av.remove_column: required [avID] | optional [blockID, keyID, columnID, removeRelationDest]
av.set_cells: required [avID] | optional [blockID, cells, items, rowID, columnID, valueType, text, number, numberFormat, date, endDate, includeTime, checked, option, options, relationBlockIDs, url, email, phone, assets]
av.set_column_options: required [avID, keyID, options] | optional [blockID]
av.duplicate_rows: required [avID, sourceRowIDs] | optional [blockID, previousID]
av.duplicate: required [avID] | optional [blockID, previousID]
av.get_primary_key_values: required [avID] | optional [keyword, page, pageSize]
av.add_view: required [avID, blockID, viewID, layout, name] | optional []
av.set_filters: required [avID, blockID, viewID, filters] | optional []
av.set_sorts: required [avID, blockID, viewID, sorts] | optional []
av.set_group: required [avID, blockID, viewID, group] | optional []
av.set_column_visibility: required [avID, blockID, viewID, keyID, hidden] | optional []
av.set_column_order: required [avID, blockID, viewID, keyIDs] | optional []
av.set_new_item_templates: required [avID, blockID, templates, defaultTemplateID] | optional []
av.create_from_template: required [avID, blockID, templateID] | optional [viewID, previousID, groupID]
av.configure_two_way_relation: required [avID, blockID, keyID, destinationAvID, backRelationKeyID, sourceName, destinationName] | optional [destinationBlockID]
av.configure_rollup: required [avID, blockID, keyID, relationKeyID, destinationKeyID, calc] | optional []
av.set_relation: required [avID, blockID, itemID, keyID, relatedItemIDs] | optional []

AV actions operate on real SiYuan attribute views (database blocks), not Markdown tables. To initialize a new AV definition, call av(action="render", blockID, createIfNotExist=true). MCP can generate the AV ID automatically and materialize a SiYuan-style NodeAttributeView block in the target document through a transaction. Requires user confirmation before: set_column_options, duplicate_rows, set_new_item_templates, create_from_template, configure_two_way_relation, configure_rollup, set_relation.

blockID.description: Exact NodeAttributeView carrier block ID; kernel fallback is not permitted

viewID.description: The exact view currently selected by blockID; MCP rejects kernel fallback.

filters.description: Complete replacement filter tree. [] clears filters and reads back as the semantic empty AND root.

column.description: Existing AV key ID for a leaf filter

anyOf.description: Typed SiYuan AV filter value. This is a Value-shaped predicate operand, not arbitrary AV JSON.

set_filters.description: Replace the complete filter array on the exact view selected by a verified carrier.

action.description: Action to perform. Supported values: get, render, get_attribute_view_keys, get_attribute_view_filter_sort, search, add_rows, remove_rows, add_column, remove_column, set_cells, set_column_options, duplicate_rows, duplicate, get_primary_key_values, add_view, set_filters, set_sorts, set_group, set_column_visibility, set_column_order, set_new_item_templates, create_from_template, configure_two_way_relation, configure_rollup, set_relation. Use action="help" for the action index, or action="help" with topic="<actionName>" for per-action details. User confirmation is required before calling: set_column_options, duplicate_rows, set_new_item_templates, create_from_template, configure_two_way_relation, configure_rollup, set_relation.

tools.name: file
tools.description:
📁 Grouped file and asset operations. Use the "action" field to select the operation.

Common actions: upload_asset, list_templates, read_template, create_template, update_template, save_doc_as_template, export_md, export_markdown_snapshot, get_doc_assets, audit_image_refs, read_image, extract_doc. Required fields: upload_asset: assetsDirPath, localFilePath; list_templates: no additional fields; read_template: path; create_template: path, markdown; update_template: path, markdown; save_doc_as_template: id, name; export_md: id; export_markdown_snapshot: notebookID; get_doc_assets: id; audit_image_refs: id, expectedRefs; read_image: path; extract_doc: id.

Additional actions: render, export_resources, list_unused_assets, get_image_ocr_text, remove_unused_assets, rename_asset, delete_asset. Read siyuan://help/action/file/{action} for details, or call action="help" if resources are unavailable.

Parameter contract per action (fields outside the action's optional list should not be sent):
file.upload_asset: required [assetsDirPath, localFilePath] | optional [confirmLargeFile]
file.list_templates: required [] | optional [query, page, pageSize]
file.read_template: required [path] | optional [offset, limit]
file.create_template: required [path, markdown] | optional [overwrite]
file.update_template: required [path, markdown] | optional []
file.save_doc_as_template: required [id, name] | optional [overwrite]
file.render: required [engine] | optional [id, path, template, preview]
file.export_md: required [id] | optional []
file.export_markdown_snapshot: required [notebookID] | optional [roots, documentIDs, limit, cursor]
file.export_resources: required [paths] | optional [name, outputPath]
file.list_unused_assets: required [] | optional []
file.get_doc_assets: required [id] | optional [assetType]
file.audit_image_refs: required [id, expectedRefs] | optional []
file.read_image: required [path] | optional [id, documentPath]
file.get_image_ocr_text: required [] | optional [path]
file.remove_unused_assets: required [] | optional []
file.rename_asset: required [oldPath, newName] | optional []
file.delete_asset: required [path] | optional []
file.extract_doc: required [id] | optional [outputDir]

file(action="upload_asset") reads a local file path and uploads that file into SiYuan assets. Because it reads the local filesystem, it requires explicit user confirmation before execution. If the file is larger than the configured large-upload threshold (10 MB by default), MCP must stop and ask the user for explicit confirmation before retrying with confirmLargeFile=true. Requires user confirmation before: upload_asset, remove_unused_assets, delete_asset.

action.description: Action to perform. Supported values: upload_asset, list_templates, read_template, create_template, update_template, save_doc_as_template, render, export_md, export_markdown_snapshot, export_resources, list_unused_assets, get_doc_assets, audit_image_refs, read_image, get_image_ocr_text, remove_unused_assets, rename_asset, delete_asset, extract_doc. Use action="help" for the action index, or action="help" with topic="<actionName>" for per-action details. User confirmation is required before calling: upload_asset, remove_unused_assets, delete_asset.

localFilePath.description: Local file path to read and upload into the assets directory [Required by: upload_asset]

confirmLargeFile.description: Set to true only after the user explicitly confirms uploading a file larger than the configured safety threshold. [Optional in: upload_asset]

query.description: Optional keyword used by SiYuan's template picker. Omit or pass an empty string to list all templates. [Optional in: list_templates]

pageSize.description: Templates per page, default 20 [Optional in: list_templates]

path.description: Template path returned by list_templates, /data/templates/... path, /templates/... static path, or path relative to data/templates / Template path to create under data/templates. Accepts relative paths such as reports/monthly.md. / Existing template path returned by list_templates, /data/templates/... path, /templates/... static path, or path relative to data/templates. / Template file path inside the SiYuan workspace / SiYuan image asset path referenced by the document, such as assets/question.png / Asset path; omit to receive an empty OCR text payload / Asset path to delete [Required by: create_template, delete_asset, read_image, read_template, update_template; Optional in: get_image_ocr_text, render]

offset.description: Character offset for partial template source reading, default 0 [Optional in: read_template]

limit.description: Maximum characters to return, default 8000 / Documents returned in this page (default 20) [Optional in: export_markdown_snapshot, read_template]

overwrite.description: When true, replace an existing template at the same path. Defaults to false. / When true, replace an existing template with the same root name. Defaults to false. [Optional in: create_template, save_doc_as_template]

tools.name: search
tools.description:
🔍 Grouped search and query operations. Use the "action" field to select the operation.

Common actions: fulltext, semantic, query_sql, get_backlinks. Required fields: fulltext: query; semantic: query; query_sql: no additional fields; get_backlinks: id.

Additional actions: search_refs, find_replace, search_assets, fulltext_asset_content, list_invalid_refs. Read siyuan://help/action/search/{action} for details, or call action="help" if resources are unavailable.

Parameter contract per action (fields outside the action's optional list should not be sent):
search.fulltext: required [query] | optional [method, methodName, types, typeShortcodes, paths, groupBy, orderBy, sortBy, page, pageSize, parentId, hasTags, stripHtml]
search.semantic: required [query] | optional [paths, types, typeShortcodes, subTypes, page, pageSize]
search.query_sql: required [] | optional [stmt, sql]
search.get_backlinks: required [id] | optional [keyword, refTreeID, scopeRootId, mode]
search.search_refs: required [id] | optional [rootID, k, beforeLen, isSquareBrackets, isDatabase, reqId]
search.find_replace: required [k, r, ids] | optional [paths, types, method, methodName, orderBy, sortBy, groupBy, replaceTypes]
search.search_assets: required [] | optional [k, query, exts]
search.fulltext_asset_content: required [] | optional [query, assetId, queryMethod, types, method, methodName, orderBy, sortBy, page, pageSize]
search.list_invalid_refs: required [] | optional [page, pageSize]

All search actions are read-only except find_replace, which modifies content and requires explicit user confirmation. search(action="query_sql") only accepts SELECT statements and preserves user-selected columns. Raw SQL is available only when every notebook is readable because aggregate, join, CTE, and subquery results cannot be safely post-filtered by notebook. When calling query_sql, always add LIMIT yourself. MCP may still truncate large result sets and will tell you when to refine the query. The blocks table columns include: id, parent_id, root_id, box, path, hpath, name, alias, memo, tag, content, fcontent, markdown, length, type, subtype, ial, sort, created, updated. In SQL results, blocks.type uses SiYuan short codes such as d=document, h=heading, p=paragraph, l=list, i=list-item, b=blockquote, c=code, m=math, t=table, html=html, video=video, audio=audio, widget=widget. Requires user confirmation before: find_replace.

action.description: Action to perform. Supported values: fulltext, semantic, query_sql, get_backlinks, search_refs, find_replace, search_assets, fulltext_asset_content, list_invalid_refs. Use action="help" for the action index, or action="help" with topic="<actionName>" for per-action details. User confirmation is required before calling: find_replace.

query.description: Search query string / Natural-language semantic search query / Semantic alias for k. Overrides k when both are provided. [Required by: fulltext, semantic; Optional in: fulltext_asset_content, search_assets]

method.description: Search method: 0=keyword (default), 1=query syntax, 2=SQL, 3=regex / Search method: 0=keyword, 1=query syntax, 2=SQL, 3=regex [Optional in: find_replace, fulltext, fulltext_asset_content]

methodName.description: Semantic alias for method: "keyword" | "query_syntax" | "sql" | "regex". The short alias "query" also maps to query syntax and overrides method when both are provided. [Optional in: find_replace, fulltext, fulltext_asset_content]

types.description: Block type filter. Accepts full names (e.g. {"heading": true}) or shortcodes (e.g. {"h": true, "p": true}). Codes: d=document, h=heading, p=paragraph, l=list, i=listItem, b=blockquote, c=codeBlock, m=mathBlock, t=table, s=superBlock, html=htmlBlock, embed=embedBlock, av=databaseBlock. / Block type filter. Accepts full names or shortcodes. / Optional block type filter / Asset type filter [Optional in: find_replace, fulltext, fulltext_asset_content, semantic]

typeShortcodes.description: Alternative shorthand type filter as array: ["h","p"]. Merged with types if both provided. / Alternative block type filter using shortcodes such as h, p, c, or av. Merged with types. [Optional in: fulltext, semantic]

paths.description: Restrict search to specific notebook IDs or storage paths / Restrict search to notebook IDs or storage paths / Optional notebook ID or storage path scope list [Optional in: find_replace, fulltext, semantic]

groupBy.description: 0=no grouping (default), 1=group by document / Grouping mode [Optional in: find_replace, fulltext]

orderBy.description: Legacy numeric sort order: 0=type, 1=created ASC, 2=created DESC, 3=updated ASC, 4=updated DESC, 5=content ASC, 6=content DESC, 7=relevance (default) / Legacy numeric sort order / Legacy numeric sort order: 0=relevance DESC, 1=relevance ASC, 2=updated ASC, 3=updated DESC [Optional in: find_replace, fulltext, fulltext_asset_content]

sortBy.description: Semantic sort alias: "relevance", "date", "updated_desc", "updated_asc", "created_desc", "created_asc", or "type". Overrides orderBy if both provided. / Semantic sort alias that overrides orderBy when both are provided. / Semantic sort alias: "relevance_desc", "relevance_asc", "updated_asc", or "updated_desc". The shorthand "relevance" maps to relevance_desc. Overrides orderBy if both are provided. [Optional in: find_replace, fulltext, fulltext_asset_content]

page.description: Page number (1-based), default 1 / Page number (1-based) [Optional in: fulltext, fulltext_asset_content, list_invalid_refs, semantic]

pageSize.description: Results per page, default 32, max 128 / Results per page [Optional in: fulltext, fulltext_asset_content, list_invalid_refs, semantic]

parentId.description: Post-filter results to blocks whose root_id or parent_id matches this ID, scoping search within a document subtree. [Optional in: fulltext]

hasTags.description: When true, only return blocks that have tags. When false, only return blocks without tags. [Optional in: fulltext]

stripHtml.description: Legacy toggle. plainContent is now returned by default; set this when you want to emphasize plain-text-safe downstream parsing while keeping highlighted HTML content. [Optional in: fulltext]

subTypes.description: Optional SiYuan block subtype filter [Optional in: semantic]

stmt.description: SQL SELECT statement to execute against the blocks/spans/assets tables; returned rows are permission-filtered [Optional in: query_sql]

sql.description: Semantic alias for stmt. Overrides stmt when both are provided. [Optional in: query_sql]

id.description: Block or document ID to find backlinks for / Referenced block or document ID [Required by: get_backlinks, search_refs]

refTreeID.description: Optional document tree ID to narrow backlink scope [Optional in: get_backlinks]

scopeRootId.description: Semantic alias for refTreeID. Overrides refTreeID when both are provided. [Optional in: get_backlinks]

rootID.description: Optional current root document ID [Optional in: search_refs]

system.get_version: required [] | optional []
system.get_current_time: required [] | optional []

Most system actions in this tool are read-only; perform_sync is the mutating exception and requires explicit user confirmation before execution. system(action="workspace_info") exposes the workspace path and is high-risk; it is disabled by default. Requires user confirmation before: perform_sync.

action.description: Action to perform. Supported values: network, conf, notify, changelog, perform_sync, get_version, get_current_time. Use action="help" for the action index, or action="help" with topic="<actionName>" for per-action details. User confirmation is required before calling: perform_sync.

mode.description: Read mode: "summary" returns a navigable overview, "get" reads a specific key path [Optional in: conf]

keyPath.description: Dot/bracket path to a specific config field, e.g. "conf.appearance.mode" or "conf.langs[0]" [Optional in: conf]

maxDepth.description: Maximum object traversal depth for summary/get responses [Optional in: conf]

maxItems.description: Maximum keys/items to include per level [Optional in: conf]

timeout.description: Display timeout in milliseconds [Optional in: notify]

version.description: Exact plugin version to read, e.g. 0.4.11 or v0.4.11 [Optional in: changelog]

fromVersion.description: Previous plugin version; returns entries newer than this version [Optional in: changelog]

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return when version is omitted [Optional in: changelog]

includeRaw.description: Include raw Markdown for each returned changelog entry [Optional in: changelog]

topic.description: Optional. Only used when action="help". Pass an action name (e.g. "create") to get per-action help; omit or use "overview" for the action index.

tools.name: flashcard
tools.description:
🃏 Grouped flashcard review and deck operations. Use the "action" field to select the operation.

Common actions: list_cards, get_decks, get_cards. Required fields: list_cards: scope, filter; get_decks: no additional fields; get_cards: deckID.

Additional actions: review_card, create_card, remove_card. Read siyuan://help/action/flashcard/{action} for details, or call action="help" if resources are unavailable.

Parameter contract per action (fields outside the action's optional list should not be sent):
flashcard.list_cards: required [scope, filter] | optional [deckID, notebook, rootID, reviewedCards]
flashcard.get_decks: required [] | optional []
flashcard.get_cards: required [deckID] | optional [page, pageSize]
flashcard.review_card: required [deckID, cardID] | optional [rating, skip, reviewedCards]
flashcard.create_card: required [deckID, blockIDs] | optional [mode]
flashcard.remove_card: required [deckID, blockIDs] | optional []

flashcard actions cover review-first flashcard workflows and deck discovery. list_cards always reads from the kernel due-card endpoints and MCP post-filters cards by state for filter="new" or filter="old"; pass reviewedCards to match SiYuan's in-review filtering. Requires user confirmation before: remove_card.

action.description: Action to perform. Supported values: list_cards, get_decks, get_cards, review_card, create_card, remove_card. Use action="help" for the action index, or action="help" with topic="<actionName>" for per-action details. User confirmation is required before calling: remove_card.

filter.description: Filter returned cards: "due", "new", or "old" [Required by: list_cards]

deckID.description: Deck ID, required when scope=deck. For scope="all", omit deckID; an empty string is treated as omitted. / Deck ID (use empty string to query across all decks) / Deck ID [Required by: create_card, get_cards, remove_card, review_card; Optional in: list_cards]

notebook.description: Notebook ID, required when scope=notebook [Optional in: list_cards]

rootID.description: Root document/block ID, required when scope=tree [Optional in: list_cards]

reviewedCards.description: Optional already-reviewed cards; SiYuan reads reviewedCards[].cardID [Optional in: list_cards, review_card]

pageSize.description: Cards per page, default 32 [Optional in: get_cards]

rating.description: Review rating passed through to the kernel [Optional in: review_card]

skip.description: When true, skip the current card instead of submitting a rating [Optional in: review_card]

blockIDs.description: Existing block IDs to turn into flashcards / Existing block IDs to remove from flashcards [Required by: create_card, remove_card]

mode.description: Compatibility option. SiYuan addRiffCards writes deck attrs and registers cards in both modes. [Optional in: create_card]

topic.description: Optional. Only used when action="help". Pass an action name (e.g. "create") to get per-action help; omit or use "overview" for the action index.

tools.title: SiYuan Flashcards

outputSchema.description: JSON object corresponding to the tool result. Non-object values are wrapped under value.

tools.name: mascot
tools.description:
🐾 Grouped mascot balance and care operations. Every successful MCP tool call earns 1 coin for the mascot. Use the "action" field to select the operation.

Common actions: get_balance, shop, buy. Required fields: get_balance: no additional fields; shop: no additional fields; buy: item_id.

Parameter contract per action (fields outside the action's optional list should not be sent):
mascot.get_balance: required [] | optional []
mascot.shop: required [] | optional []
mascot.buy: required [item_id] | optional []

mascot actions operate on the cat’s spendable balance. Every successful MCP tool call earns 1 coin for the cat, so the fastest way to earn balance is simply to keep using SiYuan MCP tools.

action.description: Action to perform. Supported values: get_balance, shop, buy. Use action="help" for the action index, or action="help" with topic="<actionName>" for per-action details.

item_id.description: Stable shop item ID returned by mascot(action="shop") [Required by: buy]

topic.description: Optional. Only used when action="help". Pass an action name (e.g. "create") to get per-action help; omit or use "overview" for the action index.

tools.name: feedback
tools.description:
💬 Submit plain-text GitHub Issue-style feedback, suggestions, or experience reports to the plugin developer. Use the "action" field to select the operation.

Common actions: submit. Required fields: submit: description.

Parameter contract per action (fields outside the action's optional list should not be sent):
feedback.submit: required [description] | optional [impact, suggestion, agent, source]

feedback submits plain-text product feedback to the developer through the configured WPS form channel. Use feedback(action="submit") when the user asks you to pass along feedback, or when an AI client needs to report MCP tool friction after explaining what will be sent.

action.description: Action to perform. Supported values: submit. Use action="help" for the action index, or action="help" with topic="<actionName>" for per-action details.

description.description: Required feedback text. Prefer a GitHub Issue-style body for bugs, confusing behavior, or rough workflows, with headings such as ## Summary, ## What happened, ## Expected behavior, ## Steps or context, ## Impact, and ## Suggested fix. [Required by: submit]

impact.description: Optional one- or two-sentence impact summary, such as affected workflow, error risk, confusion, or inconvenience. [Optional in: submit]

suggestion.description: Optional direct improvement suggestion; keep it focused and avoid repeating the full description. [Optional in: submit]

agent.description: Optional Agent product and model name, such as Claude Desktop / Claude Sonnet 4.5. Defaults to 无. [Optional in: submit]

source.description: Internal source label. Defaults to the current runtime transport. [Optional in: submit]

topic.description: Optional. Only used when action="help". Pass an action name (e.g. "create") to get per-action help; omit or use "overview" for the action index.

tools.title: Sisyphus Feedback

outputSchema.description: JSON object corresponding to the tool result. Non-object values are wrapped under value.
